exclusion_reason: Plate 1 ends at 250 kHz. Plate 2 includes 300 kHz but its additional setup description concentrates on replacement FBG sensors; do not silently mix specimens.
alloy: Not identified in source; not established as 6061-T6

model_assumptions.boundary: free plate, effective narrowband damping from 6061-T6 proxy
model_assumptions.actuator: Recorded generator waveform times assumed documented X10 amplifier setting; actual drive is unverified
model_assumptions.receivers: Coupled finite resistance and input/cable capacitance, assumed 1 Mohm and 143.5 pF
model_assumptions.bond: Finite elastic cyanoacrylate-like thin interface; E=1 GPa, nu=0.3, rho=1100 kg/m3, h=100 um, borrowed from analogous paper
omitted: resolved adhesive volume, adhesive loss and debonding
actual supports, alloy and calibrated specimen damping
model_assumptions.body_mesh_status: Selected PZT mesh retained; finite-interface variant requires its own numerical checks and convergence assessment

purpose: Exploratory controlled PZT-body comparison using existing plate-1 measurements; not exact reconstruction or training acceptance

queue_policy.order: serial, next worker only after saved output and comparison verification
queue_policy.comparison: paired arrival-time error plus full-record normalized envelope-shape difference; lower is better; unresolved signals stay unresolved
